Microsoft (MSFT) vs Intel (INTC): on the same formula, their operating margins are 51.0 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · INTC: $52.9B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · INTC: −0.5%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · INTC: −4.2%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · INTC: −0.5%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · INTC: −9.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · INTC: −9.6%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · INTC Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
